baseline.name: maximum supporting-rule confidence
baseline.description: Maximum confidence of any learned rule supporting a candidate; preserves the current baseline scoring.

experimental.name: noisy-OR over distinct supporting rules
experimental.description: For each candidate, combine one confidence per unique (body relation 1, body relation 2, target relation) rule as 1 - product(1 - confidence). Repeated paths for the same rule are stored once.
experimental.assumption: Distinct rule evidence is treated as independent for scoring; related rules can violate this assumption.

ranked_metric_status: No ranking improvement is claimed. The current candidate universe is an incomplete, rule-generated subset and is not a defined filtered full-ranking protocol.

recommended_future_ranking_protocol.candidate_universe: For each validation query, rank all entity replacements for head and tail from the training entity universe, evaluating head and tail queries separately and averaged.
recommended_future_ranking_protocol.filtered_evaluation: Filter other known true completions from train, validation, and test, then restore the target triple. Test labels must not be accessed during tuning.
recommended_future_ranking_protocol.tie_handling: Use average rank for equal scores; compute reciprocal rank from that rank and Hits@K from rank <= K.
recommended_future_ranking_protocol.sampling: Prefer full entity ranking; if resource limits require sampling, record candidate count, seed, and sampling method and label the result sampled.
